record: AISEF V2.1 — B-03b ISOLATION PROOF (before the concurrent mutation campaign)

authority.owner_words: Chạy trong môi trường kiểm thử riêng, không sử dụng client/provider thật, credential hoặc dữ liệu người vận hành. Chỉ chạy đồng thời khi cơ chế cách ly và quyền sở hữu tài nguyên đã được kiểm chứng.

method: the same 7 V2.1 targets (14 mutants; git worktrees, child processes, process ownership, the CLI and process probes, the review OCR) run by one worker alone, then by four workers at once, each worker a detached git worktree at the snapshot with env -i, a PATH holding no `opencode`, its own HOME/XDG_*/TMPDIR, wrapped by validation/v2/owned_run.py; the whole round under the machine-wide heavy lock. Isolation HOLDS when every concurrent worker's per-mutant verdicts equal the alone worker's, no run errors, no cleanup signals a process, owned_run reports no escaped process and no orphan, and the operator's real OpenCode store (os.stat metadata only, tools/store_stat.py) is not changed by the workers.

problems: iso-B aisef2/app/lineage.py::_sha: error kill tests fail on the unmutated tree (leaked 0)
iso-B aisef2/app/lineage.py::_sha: verdicts differ from the worker that ran alone
rounds.cause: not leakage between workers (every path of the failing run was under that worker's own TMPDIR): the baseline of aisef2/app/lineage.py::_sha in iso-B failed in tests/v2/test_v21_continue_integrity.py::ClaimLifecycle.test_two_runs_at_once_one_claims_and_the_other_spends_nothing — under load the second run's look for an earlier claim found the first's ('claimed by .../a ... has not begun'), so it never reached the O_EXCL race the test measures. A test-timing fault, measured from the run's own failure output (iso-B.record.json, baseline.failed).
rounds.fixed_by: 7fe1062 (the driver holds both runs at the CONTINUED-BY create and the test releases them together; expectation unchanged; old test red / new green with a run arriving 3 s late)
rounds.launch_1: the first launch of round 1 ran nothing: campaign.sh's `zsh -c` function did not see $D/$SP (launch-1-failed.nohup: writes to / refused, worker.sh not found); fixed by campaign-run.sh
rounds.operator_store: iso-alone: .local/share/opencode/log newest_entry_mtime moved 01:10:18 → 02:10:19 (entries 12 = 12; db, auth, config unchanged) — written by the operator's own OpenCode desktop app (pid 9792, started 2026-10-06 05:58 by launchd, outside every worker's process tree), on its hourly cadence (01:10, 02:10, 03:10); the workers have a scratch HOME and no opencode on PATH. iso-concurrent: unchanged.
unchanged in both windows (the app's 03:10:19 write came before the round's 03:15 start)

verdict: HOLDS at cc5359699c05 (round 2); the campaign may run its four workers concurrently at that snapshot
